messages:
jamie_ts: Heads up — our edge sample app in the monorepo fails to bundle when depending on @redwood/sdk as a workspace package. Works if I run inside packages/sdk, but from apps/sample it errors: 'Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk"'. Anyone hit this with pnpm + exports map + edge bundlers?

sara_devex: Yep. Typical culprit is a restrictive exports map + pnpm symlink layout. Some edge bundlers (esbuild in edge mode, rspack) don't consult package.json the same way Node does.

anil_eng: If exports only lists top-level import/require (e.g. "import": "./dist/index.mjs"), bundlers that want package.json or subpaths fail. Also TS server can't find types if the path isn't visible from app root.

jamie_ts: Current package.json: {"name":"@redwood/sdk","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"} — so yeah minimal.

mike_r: Quick fixes: add "./package.json": "./package.json" to exports; add wildcard "./*": "./dist/*" if you use subpaths; or provide conditional edge import: 
"exports": {"import": {"edge": "./dist/edge.mjs","default":"./dist/index.mjs"},"require":"./dist/index.cjs","./package.json":"./package.json","./*":"./dist/*"}


sara_devex: Also watch typing resolution. TS sometimes resolves via node_modules/.. so with pnpm hoisting you may need "types" + "typesVersions" or ensure the dist .d.ts is reachable. Example: 
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"typesVersions": {"*": {"": ["dist/index.d.ts"]}}

anil_eng: For local dev we added a tiny root proxy (index.mjs) that re-exports dist during postinstall to make bundlers + tsserver happy: 
// scripts/ensure-proxy.js
const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('./index.mjs', "export * from './dist/index.mjs';");
Add as postinstall in package.json. Not ideal but works while we fix exports.

jamie_ts: We're also seeing auth/retry hooks not run in edge preview. Any chance this is due to bundler tree-shaking side-effect modules?

mike_r: Yes — if your node entry imports a patch (e.g. './auth/patch-fetch') indirectly, edge bundler may drop it. Make edge entry explicit: import './auth/patch-fetch.js'; at top of dist/edge.mjs and use conditional edge export. Alternatively set "sideEffects": ["./auth/patch-fetch.js"] in package.json.

pete_buildbot: CI smoke test suggestion: add repo-root job that runs `pnpm --filter apps/sample build` to catch resolution errors early. I'll add a check to the monorepo CI template.

sara_devex: I'll draft a short packaging checklist for SDK packages in monorepos: exports (package.json), types visibility, edge conditional entry, sideEffects for patches, postinstall proxy as fallback, and CI smoke build.

jamie_ts: Awesome — I'll open a PR with package.json tweaks (add ./package.json export + edge conditional) and update sample app README. Thanks!
